findings.detail: The abstract identifies IV structural descent, retained accounts and physical constructors; [7, Section 8] and [8] are explicit antecedents.

Input 3.1 is identified exactly with RUW Theorem 3.4 at r=4, using gains 2 and 5 and uniform o(n^2) loss. The proved IV implementation is not presented as a stronger theorem. Primary definitions (3.4)-(3.5) were checked.
The first-entry antecedent is credited to [7, Section 8], compared in IV Section 8. The chosen formal proof uses IV descent localization; this is not a new localization supplied by transfer.

The note remains a separate exposition and formal assembly of part of IV through V. It claims neither a new solution nor a mathematically independent proof. The exact bound is eventual; the all-orders result retains an additive constant. The suggested merger was not adopted.
All main and companion documents carry Preprint 1.0. Draft review instructions and development chronology have been removed from their current presentation.

Full Apache 2.0 headers cover note-specific sources and gates. A per-file ownership/hash manifest and directory LICENSE/NOTICE expressly license the inherited author-owned formalization cuts. External dependencies retain their terms. Written manuscripts retain CC BY-NC 4.0.

Fresh cached root build, public endpoint gate and complete local-project axiom audit all passed. No clean rebuild of every upstream dependency is claimed. All final PDF pages were rendered and inspected.

limitations: Internal editorial and source-validation review, not independent human peer review or a certification of historical priority.
